name: relayto
description: RELAYTO for AI agents: the RELAYTO MCP server plus skills to build hand-made web pages for RELAYTO (editable in its web-content editor, published through the server) and to read any site published on RELAYTO.

interface.longDescription:
RELAYTO turns PDFs, decks, reports and web pages into interactive content that teams share from their own domain and measure page by page. Connect your RELAYTO account to work with the workspace you choose at sign-in: find content by title or by topic, create interactive content from a PDF link, a web page, HTML or a written post, edit titles, pages and settings, group content into hubs and arrange them, decide who can open each content or hub (public, unlisted, private, password or email gate), invite people to a hub by email, host files such as CSS and images for your pages, create forms and read their submissions, and read visitor analytics for a content, a hub or the whole workspace.

For marketing, sales, investor relations and HR teams who publish with RELAYTO. Every action runs as the signed-in user with that user's permissions in the chosen workspace. The connector has no tool that deletes contents or hubs, and it cannot see workspaces the user does not belong to. Tools that change privacy, overwrite settings or remove items from a hub are annotated as destructive, so clients that confirm such actions ask the user first.
capabilities: Create interactive content from a PDF, link, HTML or post
Host workspace files and create forms
Read content, hub and workspace analytics
defaultPrompt: Find our latest product decks in RELAYTO.
Turn this PDF into an interactive RELAYTO experience.
Which of our RELAYTO contents got the most visits?

positive.prompt: Find the RELAYTO contents about our product overview.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching contents of the review workspace (including Product Overview) with their titles and shareable links.

positive.description: Create a hub and add contents
positive.prompt: Create a hub called Q3 Sales Kit and add Product Overview and Pricing Guide to it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the hub, adds both contents to it and returns the hub's link.

positive.description: Change who can open a content
positive.prompt: Make Pricing Guide unlisted so only people with the link can open it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Pricing Guide, sets its privacy to unlisted and confirms the change.

positive.prompt: How many visitors did Product Overview get in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the visitors, visits and page views of Product Overview for the last 30 days, or says there were none.

positive.prompt: Which of our RELAYTO contents got the most visits?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the top contents of the review workspace by lifetime visits with their titles.

negative.prompt: Delete every content in my RELAYTO workspace.
Show me the analytics of another company's RELAYTO workspace.
Upgrade my RELAYTO plan and charge my card.

review.commerce_description: RELAYTO does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: the RELAYTO MCP server with search, content creation, hubs, privacy, files, forms and analytics, plus five RELAYTO skills.
